limits: Fixture identities and Redis INCR fence minting; no production authentication, Aurora, full Hub catch-up, Rust/FUSE, or running model agents.
1000 queued identities admitted sequentially, not a simultaneous connection burst.
One second fixture lease for killed-holder recovery; production crash recovery waits for the actual lease deadline.
Cancellation before/after acquisition and during authorization is covered by deterministic in-process tests; AWS cancellation races start after queue admission.
Subscriber disconnection uses CLIENT KILL TYPE pubsub, not a full network partition or Redis failover.
A single server SIGKILL covers initial-holder loss and expiry after promotion. Repeated server failures, Redis failover, and prolonged authority outages remain unverified.
